summary: Cloudflare is a technology company that provides a range of internet services, including security, performance, and reliability solutions for websites, applications, and networks. The company's mission is to help build a better internet by providing a platform for building, securing, and scaling applications without managing infrastructure. Cloudflare serves over 20% of the web's traffic and has a global network of over 335 cities, making it one of the largest and most trusted cloud platforms in the world. With its suite of products and services, Cloudflare aims to make the internet faster, safer, and more secure for everyone.
targetAudience: Cloudflare's target audience includes individuals, businesses, and organizations of all sizes, from small hobby projects to large enterprises, that require secure, performant, and reliable internet services.
businessModel: Cloudflare generates revenue through a variety of channels, including subscription-based plans for its security, performance, and reliability services, as well as pay-as-you-go pricing for its compute, storage, and networking services. The company also offers custom plans for large enterprises and mission-critical applications. Additionally, Cloudflare provides a free plan for personal or hobby projects, which helps to drive adoption and upsell to paid plans.
keyObservations: Cloudflare has a massive global network of over 335 cities, making it one of the largest and most trusted cloud platforms in the world.
The company serves over 20% of the web's traffic, making it a critical infrastructure provider for many online applications and services.
Cloudflare's suite of products and services includes security, performance, and reliability solutions, as well as compute, storage, and networking services.
strategicInsights: Cloudflare's focus on security, performance, and reliability has positioned it as a leader in the cloud infrastructure market, with a strong competitive advantage over other providers.

The company's global network and massive scale have enabled it to offer a range of innovative services, including serverless computing, edge computing, and artificial intelligence-powered security solutions.
Cloudflare's commitment to making the internet faster, safer, and more secure for everyone has earned it a reputation as a trusted and responsible technology company.

products.name: Cloudflare Security
products.description: Cloudflare's security services include DDoS protection, web application firewall, SSL encryption, and bot management, which help to protect websites and applications from cyber threats and attacks.

products.name: Cloudflare Performance
products.description: Cloudflare's performance services include content delivery network (CDN), caching, and optimization, which help to improve the speed and reliability of websites and applications.

products.name: Cloudflare Compute
products.description: Cloudflare's compute services include serverless computing, edge computing, and artificial intelligence-powered computing, which enable developers to build and deploy scalable and secure applications.

painPoints.explanation: Cloudflare's customers face a range of cybersecurity threats, including DDoS attacks, malware, and phishing, which can compromise the security and integrity of their online applications and services. Cloudflare's security services help to mitigate these threats and protect its customers' online presence.

Cloudflare's customers require fast, reliable, and secure online applications and services, which can be compromised by poor performance, downtime, and latency. Cloudflare's performance and reliability services help to optimize and accelerate its customers' online applications and services.

Cloudflare's customers face challenges in scaling their online applications and services, which can be limited by infrastructure constraints, including compute, storage, and networking resources. Cloudflare's compute, storage, and networking services help to enable scalable and secure applications.
